method.value: Gaurav Trivedi gave Claude Cowork a folder with Form 16, Form 12BA and the AIS/TIS downloads, plus the Claude in Chrome extension. source_text.body:
File an Indian ITR-2 with capital gains via browser agent
The author had Claude Cowork drive the tax portal in a real browser to fill every schedule, catching two mistakes in the pre-fill while keeping login and payment under their control.
Done with
CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
Gaurav Trivedi gave Claude Cowork a folder with Form 16, Form 12BA and the AIS/TIS downloads, plus the Claude in Chrome extension. The agent built a tax worksheet and classified each capital gain. After he logged in and cleared the OTP, it filled the ITR-2 schedules on incometax.gov.in. He paid the tax and e-verified himself.
How it went
Final figures reconciled to the rupee, and the return was filed and verified the same day with zero balance. The agent caught the portal's wrong filing reason, unticked schedules and a zeroed 80CCD(2) deduction. Table F's unlabeled grid needed manual checking.
Worth knowing
Reconcile Part B-TI total income and Part B-TTI tax before paying. The AIS can miss crypto, foreign assets, ESPP and some brokers, and the return isn't filed until you e-verify.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
Open the [tax portal name] in my browser and help me file my [form, e.g. ITR-2] for [year], including capital gains. Fill each schedule using the documents in [folder], compare against the pre-filled data, and list every mismatch you find. I will do the login and any payment myself, and you should pause and show me the complete return for review before final submission.
Original source: https://beingtechnicalwriter.com/file-itr-with-ai-agent/
